title: CIA-UAP-006, Sighting Of Unconventional Aircraft
what_is_it: A CIA information report documenting an eyewitness sighting of unconventional triangular aircraft near Baku, Azerbaijan in 1955.
interpretation_warnings: No OCR text was extractable from this scanned image; all facts are derived from metadata and the war.gov CSV description only.
Single eyewitness account from a US national — no corroborating sources referenced.
The document has known redactions; a redacted version was previously public, and the full extent of redaction in this release is unclear.
Cold War-era sighting near a Soviet airfield — the 'unconventional aircraft' may have been experimental Soviet military craft rather than anything anomalous.
